Theme

Latin word

volō

volō, volāre, volāvī, volātum

verb, first conjugation

fly; mean to, intend; want, wish, be willing

In this lexicon

  • fly

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 141; Traupman 212, 213, 216; Traupman 279

  • mean

    also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 19: Hic respondēre voluit, nōn lacessere.; Ter. Eun. 797: Quid tu tibi vīs?; Traupman 103: what do you mean?, quid tibi vīs?

  • want

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ph. 950: Nōlō, volō; volō, nōlō rūrsum; Cic. Att. 12.41.1: scīre tamen volēbam ubi essēs; Traupman 211, 212: Velim comparāre tesseram, I’d like to buy a ticket

  • Paucīs tē volō.: I want a word with you

    classical

Examples

  • Euax! Volāmus! Tata, volāmus!
